confidence_notes: Numbeo's June 2026 Taipei prices support the meal, cappuccino and draft-beer estimates. A July 2026 local guide gives hostel price bands; hotel estimates draw on current booking aggregates. Cocktail pricing uses a 2026 guide's casual and mid-tier ranges. Wine is less certain and estimated at about 2.7 times the local draft-beer price. Year-round accommodation pricing and taxes or fees are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct Taipei price observations were available, so no comparable city was used.
